request.deadline: 12 months; WP3 pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027.
deliverables: WP 1: Community-Facing Technical Coordination, including expert attendance at major ecosystem events and commissioning technical reports, budgeted at 256,000 ADA.
WP 2: Protocol Governance and Evolution, funding the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group, budgeted at 832,000 ADA.
WP 3: Technical Review, establishing a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027, budgeted at 105,000 ADA.
Milestone-based drawdowns, evidence-backed reporting, transparent disclosures, external assurance, and return of any unspent funds to the Cardano treasury.
request.recipient: Intersect on behalf of the vendor, with funds directed to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stated in the proposal.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect Technical Steering Committee support activities for 12 months across community-facing technical coordination, protocol governance and evolution, and technical review.

claims.claim: The TSC requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support activities for 12 months.
The requested budget is divided into 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal says all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at the moment of submission.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding in the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees have received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with stated TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-style authorization thresholds, and an external Oversight Committee.
The proposer asserts the TSC work supports Cardano technical governance, DRep decision-making, protocol evolution, ecosystem resilience, and 2030 strategy pillars.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, gives a work-package budget split, states contingency on the IntersectMBO budget, describes governance and smart-contract oversight mechanisms, cites external references for voting, audits, NCL, and contracts, and makes broader public-benefit claims about technical governance and ecosystem resilience.
